description: This file defines the JobTitle entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties such as id, job title name, description, note, deletion status, and relationships to other entities. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database schema.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM mapping annotations (e.g., ORM\Table, ORM\Entity, ORM\Column, ORM\OneToMany, ORM\OneToOne)

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: An entity class representing a job title within the HR system, including properties for identification, description, status, and associations with employees and attachments.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the job title.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the job title.

methods.name: getJobTitleName
methods.description: Gets the name of the job title.

methods.name: setJobTitleName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job title.

methods.name: getJobDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the job title.

methods.name: setJobDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the job title.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Gets the note associated with the job title.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the job title.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the job title is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the job title as deleted or active.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the associated job specification attachment, if any.

methods.name: setJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Associates a job specification attachment with this job title.
